title: Turn videos into notes you can review.
lead: Import a course, training session or industry talk. Keep original frames and timestamps, add AI highlights when needed, and save notes, PDF or PPTX.
local: Local videos are processed on your device.
ai: AI highlights require sign-in and send the necessary transcript text to the AI service.
exports: Save HTML or Markdown notes, PDF, PPTX and images.
stepsTitle: From one video to useful notes
step1: Choose a local video or try a supported video link.
step2: Similar frames are merged. Keep timestamps, remove extra pages and add missing frames.
step3: Read the notes, optionally generate AI highlights, then download your preferred format.
freeIntro: Try a video up to 10 minutes, with 3 conversions per month. Original-frame notes work without registration.
proDesc: Regular courses, meetings and longer videos.
lifetimeDesc: One purchase for ongoing use while the service operates.
dayDesc: Temporary access: 20 conversions, 300 OCR pages and 120 transcription minutes in 24 hours. Videos up to 10 minutes; one file at a time.
duringService: Current lifetime benefits remain available while Vid2PPT and the corresponding service operate.
unlimited: No plan limit; actual processing depends on your device, browser and video encoding.
emailHelp: Use the email of the account where you want to receive access. Access is linked to the purchase email.
selectPlan: Choose a paid plan to continue.
quantityHelp: Enter {min}–{max} passes. The total updates from Paddle before payment.
multiplePass: Each pass adds 24 hours to this purchase's access period. Buying multiple passes extends the duration; conversion, OCR and transcription allowances do not multiply. Existing allowances reset at the start of each calendar month.
quantityValid: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
finalAmount: Local prices are exchange-rate estimates. Paddle confirms the charge currency, taxes and final total at checkout.
readPolicies: Read the terms and refund policy before continuing. Refunds are generally unavailable once digital access is activated or used.
opened: The payment window is open. Check the plan, quantity, total and email before paying.
closed: Payment window closed. If you paid, check your confirmation email and refresh account access.
completed: Checkout completed. Access is activated by the payment webhook; check your confirmation email and account access.
returned: Returned from checkout. Confirm payment using your confirmation email and account access.
paymentFailed: Unable to open payment. Please try again or contact support.
unavailable: This plan is currently unavailable. Please contact support.
accountHelp: After purchase, sign in to the account with the purchase email, then refresh access.
freeAccess: Your account currently has Free access. If you just paid, refresh again shortly.
expiredSession: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
checkFailed: Unable to check access. Please try again.
emailMismatch: The purchase email differs from the signed-in account. Sign in to the matching account to receive access.
checkoutEnglish: Paddle does not support this language yet. Its payment window will use English.
faqLocalA: Frame extraction runs on your device. AI highlights require sign-in and send the necessary transcript text to the service.
faqAccountQ: How do I receive paid access?
faqAccountA: Use the same email for purchase and your Vid2PPT account. A verified payment webhook activates access; then sign in and refresh account access.
faqRenewA: Pro is a monthly subscription and renews each billing period. Cancel future renewal through Paddle. The 24-hour pass and Lifetime plan are one-time purchases.
faqLifetimeA: It keeps the current Lifetime plan benefits while Vid2PPT and its corresponding service operate. Processing still depends on your device and browser.
support: For payment or account questions, email info@vid2ppt.com and include your order number.
workspaceLanguage: The video editing workspace currently uses Chinese. This product and payment page is available in your selected language.
countryHelp: Choose your actual billing country. Currency and taxes follow this country; language can be changed separately.
quoteFailed: The price could not be loaded. Retry before paying.
shareHelp: Share this link with the selected language, country and quantity. Buyers can change the quantity before paying.
chargeAmount: Paddle charge: {amount}. Local amounts are exchange-rate estimates.
